ratings_why.fun: Over a 7 because the swap rule makes overlaps the cards don't print: one Landlady catches a whole Kype column, the zigzag river makes Bailiff fire on every other Leap, and Spate-Rider pulls the back row into the gap. Every turn asks which fish to ripen and where the bank folk stand.
ratings_why.distinct: Leaping along the zigzag with a six-stamp passport plays unlike today's tribes, but going home to hand with stats kept is close to the Birds' Fly South.

verdict_why: The engines interlock and the v1 holes are closed; what's left is rulings and taste, which would make it different, not better.

points.text: Print a sweep ruling: if Old Kelt swaps a fish to the Mouth halfway through a Kype or Spate-Rider sweep, does the unit swapped up still Leap? Suggest: a sweep moves only the units it listed when it began.
Reunion Secretary is the one Spawn text with no position in it. Something like 'Spawn: Run units downstream of where this Spawned gain +3/+3' would make where it ripens a choice.
Ghillie Stoat is flat gold. Tying it to timing would fit the tribe better, for example 2 gold when the passport of the unit leaping past fills up.

standouts.why: Swapped down one slot per pass, the Landlady becomes the next fish's obstacle. It's the best accidental combo in the tribe.
The Bear turns a Spawn into a choice at any Stamp count and links up with Mother Redd, Old Kelt, Uncle Faroe and Little Jack.
Old Bradán's learn-then-burst rewards gathering many Spawn texts, and Little Jack doubles it.

weakest.why: A flat team buff on Spawn that does one job.
Once-a-turn gold with no decision attached.

flags.note: With the Bear forcing a Spawn each turn, Mother Redd can make a triple, and a Discover, every two turns.
Old Kelt with Llyn Llyw and Weir-Jumper loops on Fry deaths in a fight, and the Alder gains each lap. Only board space and enemy attacks stop it.
Uncle Faroe past the Bear each turn, with Little Jack, makes 6 free gold a turn.
Old Kelt's swap to the Mouth in the middle of a sweep: it isn't stated whether the swapped unit still Leaps.
